items.title: Double-digit growth seen on corporate scoreboard in Q2, but bank, IT, pharma lag
items.description: September quarter earnings exhibited significant revenue and profit growth for various companies in key sectors. Revenue rose by 22.1% with net profit increasing by 27.5%, surpassing the previous quarter. However, banking, IT, and pharmaceuticals sectors experienced a slow down in growth rates. Excluding lending, operating margins improved, indicating stronger performance in non-banking sectors. Analysts expect 13 out of 18 sectors to deliver double-digit sales growth in the coming quarters.

items.title: Dr Reddy's bets on generic semaglutide, biosimilars
items.description: Dr Reddy's domestic formulations business grew in the September quarter, while Revlimid sales declined in North America. A relaunch of generic semaglutide and the US launch of abatacept biosimilar are anticipated for future growth. The company aims to sell millions of pens for semaglutide with a focus on international markets. Furthermore, an expanding biosimilars portfolio aims to strengthen its position beyond traditional generics.

items.title: Tata Consumer Q2 Results: Net profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 470 crore, revenue up 14%
items.description: Tata Consumer Products reported a 16% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 470 crore in Q2 FY27, with revenue rising 14% to Rs 5,661 crore. Strong Indian volumes, salt demand and growth businesses boosted performance, while EBITDA increased 18% to Rs 794 crore.

items.title: ITC Hotels reports revenues of Rs 1054 cr for Q2, PAT at Rs 203 cr
items.description: ITC Hotels reported strong second-quarter growth, with revenue rising 26% and net profit increasing 52% year on year, supported by higher room rates, occupancy and demand from business events. The company also expanded its portfolio through new hotel signings, the Welcomhotel Ahmedabad acquisition and a land allotment in Lucknow.
